transcript.text: Alright everyone, we're two weeks out from the first production customer launch for the event-ingestion service. Before I make the binding architecture decision and record the operating plan, I need to hear the final checks from both application architecture and compliance. Please go ahead and share any concrete configuration or control actions required for launch so I can capture everything in the operating plan.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: While testing an unrelated replay tool yesterday, I measured a launch-period burst of about 18,000 events per minute that the hourly batch design cannot process within the customer-facing latency target. The streaming design needs exactly 12 partitions for that load, and the launch plan must include provisioning those 12 partitions and validating replay capacity before launch. I have not yet updated the architecture document because the replay test was outside the launch checklist.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I confirmed with the privacy office this morning that the first customer's event payloads must remain in the EU and be retained for exactly 400 days for an audit requirement. The launch plan must include a data-residency control confirming that payloads remain in the EU. I hadn't added this to the launch review yet because the customer questionnaire was completed in a separate compliance system.

Implement and confirm a data-residency control ensuring all first customer event payloads remain in the EU.
Configure event payload retention for exactly 400 days to satisfy the audit requirement.
